product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - CEE 7/7 (German and French) to IEC 60320 C5 2.5A/250V 2-Prong Black 6ft
product.description: This AC power cord designed to connect a computer or other device to an electrical outlet that conforms to either the CEE 7/3 SCHUKO® (German) or the CEE 7/5 standard (French). It features a standard 2‑prong CEE 7/7 plug at one end and an IEC 60320 C5 connector, also known as a "cloverleaf" plug, at the other end.
